outcome: Untargeted lipidomics analysis of umbilical cord plasma (lipidomic profile alterations)
cohort: The study included 25 newborns from mothers with preeclampsia and 25 newborns from healthy mothers.
finding: Lipid profile disorders were identified in the umbilical cord plasma of infants born to mothers with preeclampsia, and these metabolic disturbances correlated with neonatal physical parameters at birth.
birth_weight: N/A (neonatal weight percentile was an outcome, not an inclusion criterion)
